title: Corrected full 1,433-wallet GMGN stats live rerun using one wallet per invocation
objective: Execute one manually triggered read-only Solana-only GMGN official API rerun for exactly 1,433 hash-verified valid unique wallets. Query only 7d and 30d with exactly one wallet per CLI invocation, at most 2,866 invocations/provider requests, strictly serial with at least 1,000ms spacing. Persist only allowlisted normalized unverified GMGN fields and irreversible fingerprints to a new versioned external directory. Fail closed on hash, selection, budget, or credential preconditions and require independent audit.
forbidden_actions: Do not call Helius, Chain.fm APIs, Dune, RPC, browser automation, web scraping, GMGN web pages, third-party providers, or fallback.
Do not use any chain other than Solana and do not enable BSC, Robinhood, cron, background loops, auto-discovery, ranking, or automatic daily updates.
Do not exceed 2,866 GMGN CLI invocations or provider requests. Do not retry, paginate, auto-fill, or use concurrency.
Do not query signed holdings or read, display, persist, or forward GMGN_PRIVATE_KEY. Stats authentication is API-key-only and key presence may be recorded only as a Boolean.

Do not print, persist, or commit plaintext wallet addresses, labels, credentials, proxy URLs, raw provider payloads, raw stdout/stderr, token identifiers, transaction identifiers, counterparties, or complete exceptions.
Do not write databases, Redis, caches, queues, or production systems.
Do not overwrite or reinterpret any historical 100-wallet or 1,433-wallet output.
Do not label GMGN data as chain-confirmed, verified profitability, wallet quality, UR/N/P grades, or LLM conclusions.
